title: Oil plummets and global markets rise after pause in US-Iran attacks
summary: The truce in the Strait of Hormuz causes a sharp drop in oil and boosts Wall Street, European, and Asian stock markets to new highs, while Japan evaluates its diplomatic response.

title: Bitcoin consolidates above $65,000 as crypto market shrugs off oil slump
summary: Investors turn to bitcoin as a safe haven against dollar devaluation, while companies like Strategy and Circle make strategic moves and perpetual futures attract Wall Street attention.

title: SpaceX shares fall 48% as ETFs accumulate positions and European startup competes for space
summary: Investor interest in the space sector remains despite SpaceX's share price collapse and Elon Musk's challenges, with new European players seeking a valuation of 2 billion.

title: Chinese chipmaker CXMT surges 466% in Shanghai stock market debut
summary: The semiconductor giant's IPO makes it one of the most valuable companies in China, highlighting the rise of the local chip industry amid geopolitical tensions.

title: Tech stocks rise on expectations of a key week of AI-driven earnings
summary: Strong demand for data center infrastructure boosts stocks like Nvidia, Intel and other firms ahead of their quarterly reports.

title: Porsche accelerates restructuring, plans to cut 9,000 jobs by 2035
summary: The German automaker intensifies its adjustment plan to adapt to the transition to electric vehicles and improve profitability.

title: Cracker Barrel appoints David Deno as new CEO
summary: The change in top management aims to relaunch the restaurant chain, although the news causes an initial drop in its shares.

title: Fanatics acquires BGC Group's exchange assets to create a prediction market
summary: The sports merchandise company expands into betting and financial markets with the purchase of BGC's clearing house and exchange.

title: Indonesia's central bank governor resigns, government calls for market calm
summary: The unexpected resignation of the top monetary official shakes confidence in the country's economy and prompts a call for stability from the executive.
